item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 11/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With Tropical Cyclone Yinxing departing from the coast of Guangdong and weakening gradually today, the weather will improve over the region today and tomorrow. Tropical Cyclone Toraji over the seas east of the Philippines will move across Luzon today. It will then enter the central and northern parts of the South China Sea, moving towards the coast of western Guangdong. However, there are uncertainties in its movement and intensity. Under the combined effect of Toraji and the northeast monsoon, the weather will become unsettled over the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. Winds will strengthen and there will be squally showers. Besides, an area of low pressure over the western North Pacific will develop gradually today and tomorrow, moving in the general direction of the seas east of the Philippines.
